notes: Finding re-verified at current origin/fix/p2-batch-31 (11746adc), not the stale audit clone (2295958d): deploy-do.yml had 0 attest-sbom steps, sbom.yml retained only a 30-day artifact, and docs/SBOM_PROCESS.md listed the gap.

The attestation is bound to the pushed image digest and retained durably, so a shipped image stays tied to its SBOM after the 30-day artifact window.
